xim_name.description: The name of nabi's XIM service. Useful for debugging or distinguishing multiple instances.

debug_level.description: Set the debugging verbosity level. Higher values produce more verbose output.

status_only.description: If true, nabi does not act as an input method but just displays the Hangul input status in the system tray.

sm_client_id.description: Specifies the session management ID. This option is for session manager software, not for user typing.
